issue_data.body:
I'm generating a manual with `add_toc_hook` + `render_toc_ul`. Our style guide wants the table of contents numbered (1, 1.1, 1.2, 2 …), which in HTML/CSS means `<ol>` lists, but `render_toc_ul` always produces `<ul>`.

Right now I copy the whole function into my project just to change `ul` to `ol`, and that copy has already drifted from upstream.

Proposal: an optional keyword, e.g.

```python
from mistune.toc import render_toc_ul
html = render_toc_ul(state.env["toc_items"], ordered=True)
```

which renders exactly the same structure but with `<ol>` instead of `<ul>` at every nesting level. Without the keyword nothing changes.
issue_data.title: render_toc_ul: allow a numbered (ordered) table of contents

acs.AC-FR-001-1:
Given a list of TOC items `[(1, "toc-1", "Introduction"), (2, "toc-2", "Install")]`, when `render_toc_ul(items, ordered=True)`, then `
  1. Introduction
  2. Install
`.
acs.AC-FR-001-2:
Given a nested list of TOC items `[(1, "chap-1", "Chapter 1"), (2, "sec-1", "Section 1.1")]`, when `render_toc_ul(items, ordered=True)`, then `
  1. Chapter 1
    1. Section 1.1
`.
acs.AC-FR-002-1:
Given a list of TOC items `[(1, "toc-1", "Introduction")]`, when `render_toc_ul(items)`, then `
  • Introduction
`.
acs.AC-FR-002-2:
Given a list of TOC items `[(1, "toc-1", "Introduction")]`, when `render_toc_ul(items, ordered=False)`, then `
  • Introduction
`.
acs.AC-FR-003-1: Given an empty list `[]`, when `render_toc_ul([], ordered=True)`, then `""`.
acs.AC-FR-003-2: Given an empty list `[]`, when `render_toc_ul([], ordered=False)`, then `""`.
